name: BudgeeByBonn
description: A free, installable web app for personal finance management. Track expenses, income, budgets, investments, and loans with interactive charts and automatic insights. Cloud-synced across all devices, works offline, and respects your privacy. No ads, no premium tiers — just clarity.

paragraphs: A free web app to track expenses, income, budgets, investments and loans, installable on any device and synced across them.

Budgee is a Progressive Web App (PWA) for personal finance. You record expenses and income, set monthly budgets, follow investments, crypto and loans, keep financial documents on Google Drive and set savings goals, from a phone or a computer, with the same data on every device.

It was built for people who keep their finances in a notebook or a messy spreadsheet and want something easier without giving up detail. There is no subscription, no premium tier and no advertising. It works offline and syncs when the connection comes back, and it keeps a weekly backup on your own Google Drive.
features: The Expenses tab: the action bar on top, the period selector, and the month's balance with income, spending and how much of the income you kept.

The tabs along the top lead to the sections: Expenses, Income, Savings, Categories, Investments, Loans, Open accounts, Budget and Documents. Every section opens with the same action bar: add, scan, import, search,…

The Profile menu in the header gathers what used to be a row of icons: your profile, the home country, the currency, the language, light or dark theme, the guide and sign out. The meal voucher balance sits next to it,…
Amount and currency (EUR, USD, GBP, PLN)
Category and subcategory, from a hierarchy you can customise

requirements.text: To try it without registering, open financial-management-by-bonn.web.app and click Try the demo on the sign-in screen.
The features that need real external services (Google Drive, receipt scanning, account export and deletion, password reset) say so instead of running.

What comes out is a single ZIP with the documents you picked, your deductible expenses for the year with totals, the list of what is missing (mandatory apart from optional), a note about deductible expenses paid in cash, and the list of things that do not belong in a folder, such as your IBAN, named without being included.
